text:
sophia chen: quick follow-up from today — can we get a single succinct timeline for API / Console / Optimize so teams can plan deps? cc @jess carter
marco r: +1. some folks on infra need target windows for reserved capacity planning. are we still Q3/Q4 split?
jess carter: tl;dr: API GA = early Q3, Console beta = late Q3 (invite-only), Optimize v1 = mid Q4. caveats below.
eli (eng-pl): can you call out hard gating criteria? eg. autoscale stability, end-to-end rollout tests, and SLOs?
jess carter: yes — API GA gate = 99.9% availability in staging for 48h + regression-free evals on 10 customer prompts. Console beta gate = audit logs + RBAC + two customer pilots. Optimize v1 = quantization profiles + cost savings report for sample workloads.
sophia chen: thanks. any changes to the canary/rollback plan vs what we said in the doc link? https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/all-hands-2026
marco r: i saw a note about a fallback model family for tight latency windows — will that be automatic or opt-in?
jess carter: fallback routing will be opt-out for enterprise tiers initially, opt-in for self-serve. rationale: reduce NV failures during capacity pressure but not surprise small customers.
eli (eng-pl): actionable ask: can product publish a one-pager with these dates + exact release gates by EOD Friday? engineering needs to lock sprint scope.
jess carter: yes — i'll publish one-pager and a short checklist. tagging @devops-bot to create a follow-up issue for rollout coordination. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Created issue RW-INT-4223: "All-hands: Roadmap release checklist — API/Console/Optimize" assigned to jess carter, due 2026-07-10.
sophia chen: perfect. last Q — any changes to the migration assistance plan for Dedicated customers?
jess carter: no change to migration assistance SLA; we will expand the concierge hours during Console beta. details in the one-pager. will post here when available.
marco r: thanks — calling out blockers now: capacity budgeting questions from finance, and a couple compliance items for EU customers. i'll loop in sales/finance in the issue.
sophia chen: thanks everyone. i'll share with PMs and Eng leads after the one-pager lands. :rocket:
